questions.question: If x + 1 _________ x = 2, then find the value of x 2723 + 1 _________ x 3836 यदि x + 1 _________ x = 2, तो मान ज्ञात करें x 2723 + 1 _________ x 3836
questions.questionHtml:
If x + 
1_________x
 = 2, then find the value of x2723 + 
1_________x3836

 यदि x + 
1_________x
 = 2, तो मान ज्ञात करें x2723 + 
1_________x3836
questions.solution:
The given equation x + 1/x = 2 suggests that x might be a value satisfying this equation. The solution to this equation can be obtained by recognizing that it is a form of the identity for the cosine of an angle.

In fact, the equation x + 1/x = 2 holds when x = 1, because :

1 + 1/1 = 2

Substituting x = 1 into the expression x2723 + 1/x3836 gives :

x2723 + 1/x3836 = 1 + 1 = 2
